name: OMAN SWEETS ( Under Liquidation ) SAOG
hq: Sweets of Oman SAOG Rusayal Industrial Estate Post Box 49,
description: Oman Sweets SAOG (historically known as Sweets of Oman SAOG) is currently Under Liquidation on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market, with ongoing legal wind-down proceedings including November 2026 MSX disclosures regarding a Court of Appeal judgment. Established in January 1989 and listed in January 2002 with a factory at Rusayl Industrial Estate (OMR 700,000 paid-up capital across 7.00 million shares), the company historically manufactured and marketed confectionery and sweets products across Oman and regional food markets. Following February 2023 Extraordinary General Meeting resolutions and cessation of industrial operations, shares carry a nominal market capitalization of OMR 7,000 across 467 registered shareholders.
highlights: Classified Under Liquidation on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market following February 2023 EGM resolutions, with Court of Appeal judgment disclosures filed in November 2026.
Historically manufactured confectionery and sweets at Rusayl Industrial Estate (founded 1989) serving domestic Omani and regional food retailers.
